conventions.placement: Local village projection shared with the native defense renderers: source x/y units are 1/100 tile (0.32 px/unit across, 0.16 px/unit down), altitude units draw at 0.8 px, art at 1.2x.
conventions.rotation: UseRotate art points along source +Y; it follows the projected flight tangent (atan2 - 90 degrees).
conventions.directions: DirectionCount rows use numbered roots (_1.._N, half the declared count) mirrored for leftward flight, like troop direction roots. DirectionFrame rows play their timeline on the flight clock.
conventions.ballistic: IsBallistic arcs use BallisticHeight source units as the peak altitude of a parabola between the StartHeight launch point and the target; native TrajectoryStyle curves are not reconstructed.
conventions.shadow: ShadowExportName draws on the ground under the flight point when declared.
conventions.effects: Trail emitters and projectile effects are shared packs listed in reference/full-client/effect-art.json.
